lucee.notes: The regex engine depends on the application settings (`this.regex.type`). Up to Lucee 8 the default is `perl` (Apache ORO), which is deprecated: Lucee 9 uses `java` as the default, see [[regex-migration-lucee-9]].

name: rEReplaceNoCase
description:
Uses a regular expression to search a string for a string
pattern and replace it with another. The search is
case-insensitive.
syntax: rEReplaceNoCase( string string, string regex, string substring, [string scope] )

params.name: string
params.description: A string or a variable that contains one.

params.name: scope
params.description:
- one (default): Replace the first occurrence of the regular expression.
- all: Replace all occurrences of the regular expression.
